business_summary.text: Specialty chemicals company with a 50-year history, focused on water technologies, construction chemicals, cleaning & hygiene, and chemical distribution.

call_points.text: Management maintains a positive revenue outlook across all business units for the remainder of the year.
Distribution segment saw the highest growth at 86% due to strategic initiatives.
Input cost inflation in metals like zinc and molybdenum impacted margins by about 3% in the immediate month.
Water treatment segment volume grew strongly with new client additions, and contracts run till late in the financial year.

operating_notes.text: Raw material costs started increasing from end of February and March, impacting margins.
H1 FY27 revenue growth driven by Distribution (86%) and Cleaning & Hygiene (59%).
Extreme volatility in material costs is eroding profitability despite strong sales growth.
Water Technologies segment saw 28% order book growth momentum in H1 FY27.
Operating cash flow reached ₹16.50 Cr in H1FY27 compared to ₹8.71 Cr in H1FY26.
Cost of materials consumed jumped 77.9% YoY to ₹50.39 Cr in Q2FY27.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹101.38 Cr, net profit ₹11.63 Cr.

Chembond Chemicals Limited’s Board, led by **Kiran Mukadam** (Company Secretary & AM), recommended ₹1.25 (25%) final dividend per share for FY2025-26, payable to shareholders recorded by July 24, 2026.
Kiran Mukadam (Company Secretary) shared the virtual analyst/investor meet recording on May 16, 2026, discussing audited FY/Q4 2025-26 results via Chembond’s website.

Nirmal Vinod Shah, as Promoter & Managing Director, disclosed that promoters and persons acting in concert held 1,82,83,955 shares (67.98%) of Chembond Chemicals Limited as of March 31, 2026, with no encumbrances filed.
Chembond Chemicals reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹326.15 Cr, up 12% YoY, led by its water treatment business.
Chembond Chemicals Limited will conduct H1 FY2026-27 earnings call on Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 15:00 hrs IST.
Chembond Chemicals reported H1 FY2026-27 consolidated revenue of ₹182.25 Cr, up 32% YoY, though EBITDA growth was limited to 2% due to material cost volatility.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹95.77 Cr (+31.1% YoY), net profit ₹3.26 Cr (-54.7% YoY).
Chembond Chemicals Limited provided audio/video recording of Analyst/Investor meet held 24 October 2026.
